About

AI Engineer with 4 years of Deep Learning R&D experience, I bring a dual profile that combines scientific rigor with production-grade software engineering. My belief: a reliable AI system must first be well-engineered software. Open source contributor — I publish tools and models on GitHub.

I work across the full stack — from data exploration to production deployment. Based in Toulouse, I currently build production GenAI systems at Berger-Levrault, after 4 years at CNRS/PNRIA on multidisciplinary R&D projects.
